ns2:section.sectionText: Lectures begin on Monday, 25 August 2008 and Discussions begin on Monday, 25 August 2008. MCB 250 Discussion sections will not meet the week of September 1, 2008. Examinations will be held on the following Wednesday evenings from 7:00-9:00pm: September 17, October 15, and November 12, 2008. Enrollment in this course is restricted to Sophmores, Juniors and Seniors. To be considered for an override as a Freshman, please contact Deb Bielser at bielser@life.uiuc.edu.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Not intended for students with Freshman class standing.
